competitions.title: Nuffield Research Placements
competitions.description: Paid work experience placements in STEM research over summer holidays. Looks amazing on UCAS and gain real research experience!

competitions.title: Big Bang Competition
competitions.description: Design and build a STEM project to solve a real-world problem. National finals at The Big Bang Fair with amazing prizes including technology bundles and university scholarships!

competitions.title: Into Film Awards
competitions.description: Create a short film (up to 5 minutes). Categories for animation, documentary and fiction. Ceremony in London with celebrity guests.

competitions.title: Queen Mary's Essay Competition
competitions.description: Write an academic essay on topics across humanities and social sciences. Cash prizes up to £500 and university recognition.

competitions.title: Royal Photographic Society Youth Award
competitions.description: Submit up to 3 photographs in any category. Exhibition of winning images at RPS gallery in Bristol.

competitions.title: Teen Tech Awards
competitions.description: Design innovative tech solutions to improve lives. Categories include health, sustainability, AI and accessibility.

competitions.title: Tenner Challenge
competitions.description: Turn £10 into as much as possible in one month through entrepreneurship. Learn real business skills and financial literacy.

competitions.title: BBC Young Writers' Award
competitions.description: Write a short story (up to 1000 words) on any theme. Winners published and stories broadcast on BBC Radio.

competitions.title: Raspberry Pi Foundation Competition
competitions.description: Create an innovative computing project using Raspberry Pi. Categories for beginners and advanced coders with amazing tech prizes.

competitions.title: Debate Mate Cup
competitions.description: National schools debating competition. Teams compete in regional and national rounds with coaching provided.

competitions.title: National Portrait Gallery Young Artists
competitions.description: Create a portrait in any medium. Winners exhibited at National Portrait Gallery and cash prizes up to £500.

competitions.title: John Locke Essay Competition
competitions.description: Write an essay in philosophy, politics, economics, history, psychology, theology or law. Highly prestigious for university applications.

competitions.title: Foyle Young Poets of the Year
competitions.description: Submit up to 3 poems on any theme. 100 winners published in anthology and invited to Awards ceremony in London.

competitions.title: UKMT Senior Maths Challenge
competitions.description: 90-minute multiple-choice challenge encouraging mathematical reasoning, precision of thought and fluency. Top scorers invited to British Maths Olympiad.

competitions.title: British Physics Olympiad
competitions.description: Challenging physics problems for the brightest students. Winners selected for UK Physics Team at international competitions.

competitions.title: Bebras Computational Thinking Challenge
competitions.description: Online challenge with fun puzzles involving logic, algorithms and computational thinking. No prior programming knowledge required!

competitions.title: Wildlife Photographer of the Year - Young
competitions.description: Capture stunning wildlife photography. Global competition with exhibition at Natural History Museum London.

competitions.title: CREST Awards
competitions.description: Complete a STEM project at bronze, silver or gold level. Recognised by universities and employers nationwide.

competitions.title: Young Enterprise Company Programme
competitions.description: Set up and run your own business for a year. National finals with investment prizes up to £2000.

competitions.title: Duke of Edinburgh's Award
competitions.description: Complete bronze, silver or gold award through volunteering, skills, physical activity and expedition. Recognised by universities and employers.

competitions.title: Diana Award
competitions.description: Recognition for young people making positive change in their communities. Nominated by teachers and youth workers.

competitions.title: Jack Petchey Achievement Awards
competitions.description: £250 grant for your school to celebrate your achievements. Recognition ceremony and certificate. Nominate yourself or others!

competitions.title: National Citizen Service (NCS)
competitions.description: Four-week programme combining adventure, skills and social action. Make friends, make a difference and gain skills for life!
